proposals.reason: Cursor’s first-party August 14, 2026 notice says it has officially been acquired by SpaceX. Given the completed acquisition and parent scale, Anysphere is likely not small under any plausible software-services receipts standard at this snapshot. This is a parent-control inference, not Anysphere ARR. Do not aggregate unrelated SpaceX stakeholders’ other portfolio firms absent control.

proposals.reason: The first-party UK Companies House filing history confirms ELEVEN LABS LTD filed accounts to December 31, 2025. I retrieved its filed iXBRL accounts: they report average employees of 53 for the UK company (22 in 2024) and profit of £904,321, but do not disclose turnover/revenue. That UK entity is not proven equivalent to the U.S. Marketplace entity Eleven Labs Inc. Company disclosures report ARR, not recognized annual receipts: $350M at 2025 year-end and over $500M ARR in the first four months of 2026; these are strong scale indicators but do not establish five-year SBA receipts. No public consolidated actual-revenue filing sufficient to bridge entity and receipts was found. Unknown remains appropriate.

proposals.reason: A Citizens/JMP cybersecurity-company report attributes 2023 revenue above $300M to BeyondTrust and labels its figures “Source: Company website, all revenues are CY-23.” This is a secondary summary of company-reported actual revenue, not a primary financial statement; it is a strong completed-year scale signal versus likely applicable software-services receipt standards (for example, 541512 uses $34M). BeyondTrust itself reported over $400M ARR in 2024, corroborating scale but not receipts. Official ownership disclosure says Francisco Partners acquired BeyondTrust in 2018 and Clearlake joined as an institutional shareholder in 2021; review control at the company level without automatically including every sponsor portfolio company. Likely not small, medium confidence because the CY23 actual-revenue figure is secondary and exact NAICS/five-year receipts remain unresolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Confirm selected product NAICS and public exact CY2023 revenue source underlying the company-website summary.
Confirm five-year receipts and 24-month affiliate-adjusted employee average; determine corporate parent/subsidiary boundary.
